snippet.title: Tribal Trouble Mobile Gameplay
snippet.description:
Tribal Trouble Mobile, the classic 3D cartoon RTS now on Android: build your village, gather wood, rock and iron, make weapons, train warriors and conquer the enemy island in real gameplay with touch controls.

Download free on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.synthesisenterprises.tribaltrouble
Website: https://tribaltrouble.app

0:00 The islands and how to build
0:13 Gather resources and make weapons
0:24 Make warriors, defend and attack
0:42 Chieftain lightning and conquer

• Build: tap your peons, pick a building, tap the ground
• Gather wood, rock and iron from the armory
• Make rock and iron weapons, then turn peons into warriors
• Defend your base
• Attack: select warriors, tap attack, tap the enemy building
• Team up with an ally and attack from all sides
• Use your chieftain's magic, like the lightning storm, from a safe distance

Tribal Trouble is a real-time strategy game (RTS) from the 2000s, rebuilt for phones and tablets. Lead the Vikings or the Natives in two campaigns, play skirmish against the computer offline, or play online multiplayer.

All footage is real in-game gameplay on Android.

#TribalTrouble #RTS #MobileGames #AndroidGames #StrategyGames
